references.text: Moses held his hands raised during the battle against Amalek, and as long as he kept the staff lifted, Israel won. This is similar to Joshua's outstretched hand with the spear during the battle against Ai.
God commanded Joshua to stretch out his spear toward Ai as a sign, and this verse shows that Joshua continued to hold the spear outstretched until the victory was complete.
The ban (herem) on Jericho, where everything living was devoted to destruction, corresponds to the total destruction of the inhabitants of Ai mentioned here.
Joshua struck Makkedah with the ban and devoted all living things in the city to destruction, just as he did with Ai.
The command to devote the Canaanite peoples to the ban (herem) and completely destroy them, as Joshua carried out against the inhabitants of Ai.
The law that nothing breathing should be left alive in the cities God gives Israel, and that they should be completely devoted to destruction.
